skills.name: Find Common Denominators
skills.definition: Finding the least common denominator and converting fractions with unlike denominators into equivalent fractions.

skills.name: Subtract Mixed Numbers
skills.definition: Separating and subtracting whole numbers and fractional parts in mixed numbers or whole numbers.

skills.name: Borrow from Whole Number
skills.definition: Regrouping or borrowing from the whole number part to resolve a negative fractional difference during subtraction.

skills.name: Simplify Fractions
skills.definition: Reducing the final fractional result to its lowest terms or converting fraction-only results to integers.

skills.name: Subtract Pure Fractions
skills.definition: Subtracting fractions directly when there are no whole number components in the original problem.
